_doc: TAM-recall seed registry. Each seed's gold set is the exhaustive G2 category roster (Tier-A, vendor-neutral published market) resolved to company domains via the G2 Data API, then frozen. G2 covers software markets only; non-software seeds (trades/real-estate/field services) must use trade-association/NAICS sources instead.
_firmographics_doc: Optional, REPRESENTATIVE firmographic hints for the TAM, derived from public knowledge of each category (vendor-neutral) — NOT from the gold set. They let runners exercise a vendor's documented firmographic filter surface (e.g. OpenFunnel locations / employee range / funding stages) so each API can put its best foot forward. Ranges are intentionally generous to avoid excluding legitimate TAM members. The orchestrator sweeps filtered + unfiltered configs and keeps whichever maximizes recall, so these can only help, never penalize.

seeds.description: SMS marketing platform for Shopify e-commerce brands.
Subscription management and recurring billing for e-commerce.
Field service management software for the trades.
B2B customer support platform / conversational support.
